svysem

Design-based structural equation models for complex survey data. The model is fitted with lavaan. Sampling weights, clustering and stratification come from a survey design, the procedure of Mplus TYPE = COMPLEX.

Continuous outcomes use MLM (Satorra-Bentler) or MLR (Yuan-Bentler), including missing = "ml". A model with group= uses replicate weights for MLM, so a between-group contrast keeps the covariance from primary sampling units that contain both groups. Ordered indicators use WLSMV, with replicate-weight standard errors. predict() returns factor scores for continuous outcomes. A svyrep.design is accepted.

Completed data sets from a multiple imputation are fitted one by one and pooled with Rubin’s rules. The design degrees of freedom are the complete-data degrees of freedom.

The method for a single design follows Oberski (2014, doi:10.18637/jss.v057.i01). No code is taken from lavaan.survey.
